code: local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local o={} for _,k in ipairs({"TutorialStep","GuideOff","ProfileReady","QuickInit"}) do table.insert(o,k.."="..tostring(p:GetAttribute(k))) end local c=p.Character table.insert(o,"cape="..tostring(c and c:GetAttribute("OpeningCapeState")).." reason="..tostring(c and c:GetAttribute("OpeningCapeReason"))) table.insert(o,"capeModel="..tostring(c and c:FindFirstChild("MeadowWornCrimsonCape")~=nil)) return table.concat(o," ")

local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local o={} for _,d in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 then local t=d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Text or "" table.insert(o,string.format("%s|%s|%s|%d,%d|%dx%d",d.ClassName,d.Name,t,d.AbsolutePosition.X,d.AbsolutePosition.Y,d.AbsoluteSize.X,d.AbsoluteSize.Y)) end end return table.concat(o,"\n")
